name: Hilda's Blueberries U-Pick
description: A family-run u-pick farm in Madison, FL, Hilda's Blueberries U-Pick grows Blueberries. The farm is busiest in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
